refnamediv.refpurpose: Calculate the inverse Fast Hartley Transform of real input.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: m = ifht(d) m = ifht(d, n) m = ifht(d, n, dim)

listitem.para: Real or complex scalar, vector, or matrix.
(optional) Integer specifying the number of elements of d to use. If n is larger than the dimension along which the ifht is calculated, d is resized and padded with zeros. If smaller, d is truncated.
(optional) Integer specifying the dimension of the matrix along which the ifht is performed.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Calculates the inverse Fast Hartley Transform of real input d. If d is a matrix, the inverse Hartley transform is calculated along the columns by default.
